title: Reported prerequisite blocker creates a launch risk

turns.user: Omid owns the database migration due tomorrow at noon. Sara owns the launch due in three days at noon. Track both as delegations. The launch depends on the migration.
Omid reported: Migration is blocked by missing database access. Record that blocker.
What needs my attention on these delegations?

reply.judge: Identifies the reported migration blocker and its risk to the launch; does not assert the launch has failed or definitely will miss its deadline.
